summary: Configures which admission heads are active and collectible at specific stages of the admission pipeline. It also allows setting whether the amount for a particular head can be edited during collection and provides a utility to copy these settings across multiple courses.
steps: Select and 'View' the desired admission stage (e.g., 'Lead Stage', 'Data Requested Stage', 'Approved Stage').
Go to the 'Transactions' tab within the selected stage.
Select the 'Course' for which the transaction is being configured.
Select the 'Head' (e.g., 'Registration', 'Prospectus Fees', 'Visit Fee') that will be collected at this stage.
Enter the default 'Amount' for the selected head.
If 'Editable' is ON, the amount can be modified by the user during the collection process.
If 'Editable' is OFF, the amount is fixed as configured and cannot be changed during collection.
To apply the same transaction mapping to all other courses, click 'Copy Course Head'.
Click 'Update' to save the transaction configurations for the stage.
business_rules: Transactions can only be collected for heads that are mapped to the current admission stage.
A single stage can have multiple admission heads mapped for collection.
The 'Editable' setting determines if the collected amount can be overridden by the user.
important_notes: The specific heads and their 'Editable' status at each stage should align with the institution's admission and payment policies.
'Copy Course Head' is a time-saving feature for institutions with many courses requiring similar transaction mappings.
